Il regolamento europeo 2019/1157 manda i: European regulation 2019/1157 retires the paper ID card: it is no longer valid even if the printed expiry date is later. You need the CIE.
Le convenzioni con i gestori SPID sono s: Agreements with SPID providers have been renewed until 2027. Meanwhile some providers charge a fee and the State is pushing CIE and IT-Wallet in the IO app.
La domanda va inviata prima che il perme: The application must be sent before the permit expires — as a rule at least 60 days before. Waiting until the last day risks weeks without a valid document.
Ogni ISEE vale fino al 31 dicembre dell’: Each ISEE is valid until 31 December of the year it was requested. From January a new DSU is needed, otherwise the single allowance drops to the minimum.
Le finestre di invio del 2026 (12 gennai: The 2026 submission windows (12 January, 9, 16 and 18 February) have passed. The next chance is the 2027 decree: get ready now.
La domanda di rinnovo va presentata prim: The renewal application must be submitted before expiry using the Poste Italiane postal kit. Check the date on your permit and gather the documents in advance.
Con il numero di assicurata della ricevu: With the registered-post number on your receipt you can check how far along your application is directly on the Polizia di Stato website.
Sostegno mensile dell’INPS per le famigl: A monthly INPS payment for families with dependent children. The amount depends on the ISEE: update your ISEE so you don't get the minimum.
L’ISEE serve per Assegno Unico, bonus, m: The ISEE is needed for the single allowance, bonuses, school meals and housing calls. The DSU must be updated every year: the previous ISEE expires and must be redone.
Se hai redditi da lavoro in Italia potre: If you have employment income in Italy you may have to file the 730. The pre-filled form is available online in the Revenue Agency's private area.
Se perdi involontariamente il lavoro puo: If you lose your job involuntarily you can claim NASpI from INPS. The application must be filed within a set deadline from the end of the employment.
Con un permesso valido hai diritto all’i: With a valid permit you are entitled to register with the SSN and get a family doctor. Registration is done at the ASL of your municipality of residence.
Molti Comuni pubblicano bandi per allogg: Many municipalities publish calls for social housing (ERP) and rent contributions. Application windows are short: check your council's notice board.
La domanda di cittadinanza (per residenz: The citizenship application (by residence or marriage) is submitted on the Interior Ministry's portal. Translated and legalised documents are required.
